verdict.rationale: Pipecat is an open-source framework with a hosted Pipecat Cloud, so data export and exit is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents no first-party feature for exporting all of a user's data in open formats. AudioBufferProcessor recording and transcript collection are developer building blocks for capturing conversation data, not an export capability. Bot-code portability across the runner, Cloud and self-hosting is an adjacent feature that covers moving code, not exporting data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
